posts.name: EigenZero
posts.cooked: Hey guys! Brand new to the forums so I'm still getting my profile together.  I was just wondering how often the store here gets restocked.  I randomly stumbled upon the Oblivaeon kickstarter thanks to a friend and have been slowly buying up all of the game I can, but noticed that The Scholar is out of stock.  After finally getting to his episode on The Letters Page, I'm really interested in getting a hold of him and his deck without paying the $60+ on Amazon for him.  Just looking for a ballpark of how long it usually takes for a product to show back up.  Thanks everyone, and I'm looking forward to being a member of what already looks like a great community!
